scopeReview: CED Topic 1.6 LIM-1.E: factor/cancel on punctured neighborhoods, rationalize, expand, combine rational expressions and use absolute-value cases. Real root domains and remaining denominator restrictions are stated. No assessed derivative rule, L’Hospital procedure or BC technique is required.
varietyReview: Ten raw-expression two-sided numerical checks accompany separately worked exact algebra; the remaining factor/cancellation item has an independent remainder/factor-theorem check. Mixes linear/quadratic/cubic factors, roots and nested fractions, a two-factor radical cancellation, a cube-root identity, sign-sensitive absolute value and invalid cancellation. Numerical sampling is corroboration, not a proof of arbitrary limits.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
